ownership.scope: one broker per research-engine daemon process shared by deterministic and semantic workers
ownership.formula_owner: one long-lived subprocess in isolated Docling/CodeFormulaV2 runtime
ownership.table_owner: one long-lived subprocess in isolated PaddleOCR/PP-TableMagic runtime
ownership.deterministic_workers: all deterministic workers receive the same broker instance
ownership.qwen_verify_owner: optional one long-lived Qwen3.5-4B subprocess under the exact certified native-sampler-v3 runtime when bounded VERIFY is enabled

scheduling.cross_family_execution: formula on GPU 0 may run concurrently with the active GPU 1 family; table and qwen_verify are mutually exclusive residents on GPU 1
scheduling.qwen_table_residency: table and qwen_verify share GPU 1 by default but are never resident/active simultaneously; family switching waits for current-family requests to drain, evicts the idle resident subprocess, then starts/reuses the requested family
scheduling.same_family_queueing: requests for the currently resident family continue through that LocalModelOwner bounded FIFO and are not serialized outside the owner queue

table.model_family: PaddleOCR 3.7.0 General Table Recognition v2 / PP-TableMagic

runtime_boundaries.protocol: newline JSON requests with prefixed JSON responses over subprocess stdin/stdout
runtime_boundaries.server_logs: stderr redirected to per-family log files

qwen_verify.enabled_for: radius-0 VERIFY, partitioned into independently bounded cited-page units; whole-job local success requires unanimous verified=true, no issues, and full authoritative-ID acceptance across every page
qwen_verify.fallthrough: untouched whole VERIFY job goes to STANDARD Codex if any page is ineligible, backpressured, runtime-failed, guard-failed, negative, partial, or issue-bearing

lambda_acceptance.first_wave: 3 formula page requests + 3 table crop requests submitted concurrently
lambda_acceptance.warm_wave: 1 formula + 1 table request repeated concurrently using the same owners
checks: exactly one server PID observed for formula requests
exactly one server PID observed for table requests
owner spawn_count remains 1 for each family
GPU peak memory/utilization and host memory are sampled
lambda_acceptance.qwen_verify_gate: separate stopped-daemon gate must prove exact runtime identity on one real multi-page historical VERIFY: deterministic page-scoped units, one resident Qwen model boot reused across all page calls, zero Codex calls, unanimous local full acceptance, strict agreement with the existing full-job Codex result, no document-owner spawn, no process leak, and no scientific-state materialization before production enablement

production_enablement.default: disabled until Lambda concurrency gate passes
production_enablement.shutdown: daemon owns broker lifecycle and closes both model-owner subprocesses
production_enablement.qwen_verify_default: disabled in code until explicit production env enablement after Lambda gate
production_enablement.qwen_verify_authority: authoritative PDF page and pre-existing authoritative evidence IDs
